## What's the need
One or two sentences. The problem or gap, not the solution yet.

## Why now
The pain or opportunity driving this.

## Done when
How you'd know this is finished — testable, not a feeling. Good requests become a `requirement@1` with `done_when` criteria.

## Boundaries
Does this belong in Wisp, or in Monokl (code intelligence), Michi (rendering), or Wisp Plugins (agent workflow)? See `PRINCIPLES.md`.
